purpose: Decide whether a d1-2B decision model can replace Gemma 4 E2B as Bouncer's per-post filter classifier.

candidates.why: Same d1-2B checkpoint as Ollama's d1:2b; leave-one-out 85/88 exact with 0 false hides; widest stable cutoff interval among GGUF builds; 1.85 GB on disk.
Same checkpoint on Ollama's MLX runner; the Ollama build that meets the size bar (1.75 GB disk, 1.76 GiB footprint), fastest warm latency; leave-one-out 83/88 with 1 false hide.

notCandidates.ollama-d1-2b-mxfp8: Above the pre-set size bar (2.43 GB disk, 2.40 GiB footprint).
notCandidates.llama-d1-2b-q4km: Smallest d1-2B build, but its optimal cutoff interval is only 0.0048 wide, so the frozen cutoff is fragile; revisit with fresh data if a d1-2B candidate passes.
notCandidates.llama-d1omni2b-q8: Different checkpoint; below d1-2B on discovery.
notCandidates.kev and laya variants: Below d1-2B on discovery at similar or worse cost.
notCandidates.llama-d1omni600m-q8: 75/88 with 4 new false hides on discovery.

baseline: Browser Gemma 4 E2B (LiteRT-LM 0.17.0) per-case verdicts, paired by case identity and hash.

gatesPerCorpus.G1_newFalseHides: at most 1 false hide on a case Browser showed correctly
gatesPerCorpus.G3_hideDecisions: correct hide/show decisions >= Browser's count minus 1

passRule: A candidate passes only if G1, G2 and G3 all hold on both corpora at its frozen template, cutoff and runtime settings.
reportedNotGated: text-only QAT comparison on the migration corpus
productBarAlreadyMeasured: Warm 10-filter p50 at or below Browser's 400 ms, about 2 GB or less on disk, about 2 GiB or less resident; both candidates meet it on phase-1b measurements.
rules: Run validation once per candidate; no retuning, template change or cutoff change afterwards.
Refuse to run if any frozen runtime setting, artifact identity or corpus hash differs.
If neither candidate passes, the conclusion is that d1-2B is not yet a clear replacement; keep the harness for future models.
